name: d2
description: Modern diagram scripting language for creating technical diagrams as code with multiple output formats

d2.description: Diagram scripting language compiler generating technical diagrams from declarative text descriptions
d2.usage:
d2 diagram.d2 output.svg # Compile to SVG (default format)
d2 diagram.d2 output.png # Generate PNG image
d2 diagram.d2 output.pdf # Create PDF document
d2 --theme=1 diagram.d2 dark.svg # Apply dark theme
d2 --sketch diagram.d2 hand-drawn.svg # Hand-drawn sketch style
d2 fmt diagram.d2 # Format D2 source code
d2 validate diagram.d2 # Validate syntax and structure
d2 play diagram.d2 # Interactive preview in browser
d2 layout tala # Show available layout engines
d2 --watch diagram.d2 output.svg # Auto-recompile on file changes
